rationale: Stage-II is an intervention for the observed continuous-pairwise regression. A majority trigger based on either protected objective is insufficient because absolute-only conflict does not diagnose the target failure mode.

all_required: the frozen Stage-I result passes its formal completion and authorization validator
exactly 30 Stage-I steps expose finite pairwise candidate directional derivatives and cosines
g_pairwise dot u0 is strictly below -1e-12 on at least 16 of 30 steps
the deterministic median of all 30 pairwise candidate cosines is strictly below zero
stage_ii_authorization.median_definition: arithmetic mean of sorted positions 15 and 16 for the fixed even count 30

stage_ii_method.optimizer_candidate: ordinary AdamW descent displacement including advanced moments and decoupled weight decay
stage_ii_method.projection: minimize ||u-u0||^2 subject to g_absolute dot u >= 0 and g_pairwise dot u >= 0
